caption: Left: Relative share of the most frequent languages in the dataset. Right: Distribution of contributions among users.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the relative share of the most frequent languages in a dataset, comprising nine distinct categories. The chart is divided into nine slices, with the largest portion representing English at 42.8% in dark blue, followed by Spanish at 31.4% in blue, Russian at 5.7% in a lighter blue, German at 3.6%, French at 2.9%, Chinese at 2.5%, Thai at 1.9%, Portuguese (Brazil) at 1.7%, and Catalan at 1.6%, all in progressively lighter shades of blue, and a final category labeled "Other" at 5.8%. The percentages are displayed directly on the chart for the largest categories, while the remaining slices are labeled outside the chart. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices appear to be ordered in descending size. The language labels are positioned outside the corresponding slices, and some slices are labeled with their respective percentages directly on the chart.
